name: Roasted poblano rajas
status: PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE — NOT COOKED OR TASTED

lines.prep: roasted over flame/broiler until blistered, steamed 10 min, peeled, seeded, cut in strips, drained and patted dry

method: Roast whole poblanos (about 30 min total including steaming), peel, seed, strip, drain and pat dry (target EP 440 g from about 800 g AP).
Sauté onion until soft; add chile strips, salt and lime; cook briefly and drain again.
Cool and hold; keep drained so the quesadilla does not leak.
estimates_label: All quantities, yields and shelf-life values are preliminary estimates until tested by a person in a kitchen.
